ipLookupLive.title: Network
ipLookupLive.description: Cached data is free. Paid refresh updates quality and network data.
ipLookupLive.cloudflareHelp: Optional ASN traffic proportions. Configure an Account Radar Read token. Leave blank to keep the current token.

errors.IP_DETAILS_UNAVAILABLE: Live details are temporarily unavailable. Try refreshing.
errors.IP_DETAILS_BUSY: A live lookup is already running for your account.
errors.IP_DETAILS_RATE_LIMITED: Live lookup rate limit reached. Try again shortly.
errors.IP_DETAILS_PLAN_RESTRICTED: This provider plan cannot check this block.
errors.IP_DETAILS_AUTH: Provider credentials could not be accepted.
errors.IP_DETAILS_INVALID_RESPONSE: The provider returned incomplete or invalid data.
errors.IP_LOOKUP_INVALID_IP: Enter a public IPv4 or IPv6 address.
errors.IP_LOOKUP_FAILED: Live details could not be loaded. Try refreshing.
errors.IP_LOOKUP_REFRESH_REQUIRED: Use paid refresh to update IP quality and network data.

traffic.context: Cloudflare-observed HTTP traffic for the selected ASN over seven days. These proportions and network abuse ratios describe the wider network.

graph.instructions: Scroll or pinch to zoom. Drag to pan. Keyboard: arrows, + / -, 0 to fit.
graph.truncated: Results are bounded; some paths or origins were omitted.
graph.context: The graph retains three observed hops and observed T1 endpoints. Dashed paths summarize omitted hops; they do not imply adjacency.
graph.tier1Fallback: No classified T1 path; showing observed hops.
graph.tier1Context: T1 uses CAIDA's dated transit-free clique inference. Unknown classifications stay unknown; commercial agreements are not verified.

upstreamsEmpty.unknown: Direct connections are unclassified; transit upstreams are unknown.

graph.focusHelp: Select a route to focus its observed links. Compressed segments show their actual AS hop count.

ipLookupLive.shodanContext: Queried live from Shodan's weekly-updated dataset. This is not a fresh port scan; no per-host observation time is supplied.
ipLookupLive.cacheSubnet: Cached data for {ip} in the same /24 · {date}
ipLookupLive.legacyData: Older cached data. Refresh to load the new routing details.
